mapper.sql:
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
AND p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
AND p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
AND p.pay_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 YEAR)
AND p.pay_status = #{status}
AND pr.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')

WHERE ja.user_id = #{userId}
AND ja.app_step NOT IN ('최종합격','최종불합격','최종발표')
AND ja.app_step IN ('최종합격','최종불합격','최종발표')
AND jp.close_date >= CURDATE()
AND jp.close_date < CURDATE()
AND ( jp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR uc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

WHERE r.person_user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_active = 1 AND jp.post_status = 1 AND jp.close_date >= CURDATE()
AND ja2.job_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT resume_my_id , user_id , resume_id , title , status , memo , created_at , updated_at , DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated_at_str , is_deleted FROM resume_my WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, resume_my_id DESC

SELECT resume_my_id , user_id , resume_id , title , status , memo , created_at , updated_at , DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated_at_str , is_deleted FROM resume_my WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY (status = 'COMPLETE') DESC , updated_at DESC , resume_my_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cover_letter_idx , user_id , title , company_name , save_status AS status , created_at , DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at_str FROM cover_letter WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_bookmark jb INNER JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = jb.job_id INNER JOIN USER_COMPANY uc ON uc.user_id = jp.comp_id WHERE jb.user_id = #{userId}
AND ( jp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR uc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND jp.close_date >= CURDATE()
AND jp.close_date < CURDATE()
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JOB_APPLICATION ja WHERE ja.user_id = jb.user_id AND ja.job_id = jb.job_id )

SELECT p.pay_id, p.user_id, p.product_id, DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_date, '%y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS pay_date_text, p.pay_price, p.pay_status, p.pay_method, pr.product_name FROM PAY p JOIN PRODUCT pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY p.pay_date DESC LIMIT #{page.offset}, #{page.safeSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAY p JOIN PRODUCT pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id

SELECT ja.app_id , ja.job_id , uc.company_name , jp.title , jp.exp_type , jp.exp_year , jp.edu , jp.emp_type , jp.address , jp.close_date , (jp.close_date < CURDATE()) AS closed , ja.app_step , DATE_FORMAT(ja.apply_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS apply_date_str , CASE WHEN ja.app_step IN ('최종합격','최종불합격','최종발표') THEN '최종발표' ELSE '지원완료' END AS status_label FROM JOB_APPLICATION ja JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = ja.job_id JOIN USER_COMPANY uc ON uc.user_id = jp.comp_id
ORDER BY jp.close_date ASC, ja.apply_date DESC
ORDER BY jp.close_date DESC, ja.apply_date DESC
ORDER BY ja.apply_date DESC, ja.app_id DESC
LIMIT #{page.offset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{page.safeSize, jdbcType=INTEGER}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JOB_APPLICATION ja JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = ja.job_id JOIN USER_COMPANY uc ON uc.user_id = jp.comp_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECOMMENDED_JOB r JOIN JOB_POSTING jp ON jp.job_id = r.job_id
LEFT JOIN JOB_APPLICATION ja2 ON ja2.job_id = jp.job_id AND ja2.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_bookmark(user_id, job_id, reg_date) VALUES(#{userId}, #{jobId}, NOW())
